CustomField.description: Created 1/21 to help ensure the project Details are correct
CustomField.formula: If( SOW_Hours__c <> Total_Estimated_Hours__c && TEXT(Billing__c) = "T&M" , IMAGE("https://doextra--c.na104.visual.force.com/resource/1411571084000/GraphicsPack/32/fatcow/farmfresh/cancel.png", "Stop") & " Total Project Line Item hours(" & TEXT(Total_Estimated_Hours__c ) & ") do not match SOW Hours(" & TEXT(SOW_Hours__c) & ")" & BR() , "") & If( Total_Assignment_Hours__c < SOW_Hours__c , /*IMAGE("https://doextra--c.na104.visual.force.com/resource/1411571084000/GraphicsPack/32/fatcow/farmfresh/error.png", "Caution") & */IMAGE("https://doextra--c.na104.visual.force.com/resource/1411571084000/GraphicsPack/32/tangodesktopproject/theme/go-down.png", "ArrowDown") & " Total Assignment Hours(" & TEXT(Total_Assignment_Hours__c) & ") are LOWER than SOW Hours(" & TEXT(SOW_Hours__c) & ")" & BR() , "") & If( Total_Assignment_Hours__c > SOW_Hours__c , /*IMAGE("https://doextra--c.na104.visual.force.com/resource/1411571084000/GraphicsPack/32/fatcow/farmfresh/error.png", "Caution") & */IMAGE("https://doextra--c.na104.visual.force.com/resource/1411571084000/GraphicsPack/32/tangodesktopproject/theme/go-up.png", "ArrowUp") & " Total Assignment Hours(" & TEXT(Total_Assignment_Hours__c) & ") are HIGHER than SOW Hours(" & TEXT(SOW_Hours__c) & ")" & BR() , "") & If( Project_Rate__c <> Average_Assignment_Rate__c && More_than_one_Rate__c <> TRUE , /*IMAGE("https://doextra--c.na104.visual.force.com/resource/1411571084000/GraphicsPack/32/fatcow/farmfresh/error.png", "Caution") & */IMAGE("https://doextra--c.na104.visual.force.com/resource/1411571084000/GraphicsPack/32/fatcow/farmfresh/emotion_suprised.png", "Surprised") & " At least one assignment has a rate that is different than the Project Rate field" , "")
CustomField.label: Record Validation
